role: set of bounded continuous real functions on a topological space S
notes: Handbook notation; Durrett p. 119 writes 'every bounded continuous function g' without a symbol for the class.

role: weak convergence of Borel probability measures on a topological space, tested by C_b(S)
notes: Durrett's arrow for weak convergence (pp. 116-120); on the real line it coincides with def:p15-weak-law-convergence by thm:p15-w02c-p15-004-topological-weak (ii). Distinct from the global sequent arrow of Parts 2-12.

role: point mass (Dirac probability measure) at a point x
notes: Same role as the unregistered use in thm:p15-weak-convergence-boundaries. Durrett's remark on p. 120 writes P(X_n = x_n) = 1 instead.

role: distance from a point to a nonempty closed set in a metric space
notes: Infimum of d(x,y) over y in K; local to the proof of uniqueness of limits.

role: Baire space of all natural-number sequences
notes: Handbook notation; Moschovakis 2009 writes the same space with a script N. Not the standard normal law or a null-set class.

role: basic neighbourhood of sequences extending a finite sequence s
notes: Local to the cardinality section and its annex proofs.

role: restriction of a sequence alpha to its first k terms
notes: Not divisibility or conditioning; local to the cardinality section.

role: set of binary sequences indexed by the natural numbers
notes: Equinumerous with the power set of N and with the real line (thm:p15-w02c-p15-004-reals-continuum).

role: nice map: injective map from a measurable space into R, measurable in both directions (Durrett's definition, no Borel-image clause)
notes: Durrett p. 53 writes the same map with a Greek phi. Distinct from the Borel real coding phi of thm:p15-metric-borel-representation, which is a nice map with Borel image by thm:p15-w02c-p15-004-nice-coding.

role: fractional part t minus the floor of t, in [0,1)
notes: Local to the counterexample proof; not an inner product or a generated structure.
Local to the counterexample proof; not exclusive disjunction or a direct sum. Companion r minus s modulo 1 is written with \ominus.

role: rotation of [0,1) by r: x maps to the fractional part of x plus r
notes: Local to the counterexample proof; preserves Lebesgue measure on Borel subsets of [0,1).

role: diagonal map u to (u,...,u) from A_n into the n-fold product
notes: Local to the counterexample proof; not a difference operator or a boundary.

notes: Source notation recorded only to identify it; the handbook writes f_{Y_n}(y) (thm:p15-weak-central-order-statistic).
